content.title: Bosch Rexroth M12x60-12.9 Hex Bolt, M12 x 1.75, 60mm Length, Class 12.9 Alloy Steel, ISO 898-1
content.short_description: Bosch Rexroth M12x60-12.9 external hex bolt, M12 x 1.75 thread, 60 mm length, property class 12.9 alloy steel, rated to 1220 MPa tensile strength per ISO 898-1.
content.long_description:
The Bosch Rexroth M12x60-12.9 is a hex head bolt manufactured from alloy steel to property class 12.9, providing a minimum tensile strength of 1220 MPa. The fastener features an external hex drive for use with standard hex sockets or wrenches, and is dimensioned per M12 thread size with a 1.75 mm pitch and 60 mm overall length.

This bolt is manufactured to ISO 898-1, which defines mechanical and material property requirements for bolts, screws, and studs made from carbon and alloy steel. Class 12.9 is a high-strength grade suited to applications requiring elevated tensile and yield strength compared to lower property classes.

Use this part number to cross-reference against existing M12 x 1.75 x 60 mm hex bolt specifications when sourcing replacements or matching bill-of-material requirements for equipment built to metric fastener standards.
